Josh Jacobs.news_note: Back at practice after groin issue. Packers discussed contingency planning in case of a suspension; no suspension had been announced in the transcript.

Chuba Hubbard.news_note: Hamstring issue has kept Hubbard from practicing; analysts still see role value when healthy.

Jacory Croskey-Merritt.news_note: Lower-body issue described as not expected to be serious.

Rachaad White.news_note: Hamstring injury had kept White out for roughly a week. Passing-game versatility remains a key role edge.

Puka Nacua.injury_status: GROIN - MISSED SIGNIFICANT TIME / SUSPENSION MONITOR
Puka Nacua.news_note: Missed significant time with a groin injury; transcript also mentioned possible suspension risk. Analysts had not moved him out of their elite WR tier yet.
Puka Nacua.rank_review_reason: Elite rank retained for now, but groin/suspension status needs final pre-draft verification.

Emeka Egbuka.news_note: Toe injury is being monitored, but transcript reports little pessimism about Week 1 availability.

Luther Burden III.news_note: Returned to practice and is trending toward Week 1. One analyst had him in the middle/high Round 4 range after the positive health update.

Josh Downs.news_note: Calf injury is active; analysts want him back on the field before treating his role/value as fully stable.

Alec Pierce.injury_status: OFF PUP - ANKLE RECOVERY / LIMITED RETURN
Alec Pierce.news_note: Activated from PUP, but analysts want to see multiple team practices before treating him as fully healthy or fully integrated into the expanded route role.

Tyler Warren.news_note: Battling a groin injury. Analysts still prefer Warren as the Colts passing-game piece/tight end to draft, but health needs final confirmation.

Sam LaPorta.news_note: Back in a physical practice and 11-on-11 work after the hip issue; analyst expressed little injury concern.

Tucker Kraft.injury_status: ACL RECOVERY - OFF PUP / SNAP LIMIT ENDING

George Kittle.news_note: Activated from PUP and trending positively, but Week 1 remains uncertain enough that analysts suggested a backup tight-end plan.

D'Andre Swift.draft_intel_note: Beneficiary of Monangai camp absence; stable receiving role plus contingent rushing upside.
D'Andre Swift.news_note: Monangai knee absence has increased Swift early-season workload/contingent upside; analysts placed him in the Round 3-4 RB tier.

Jonathon Brooks.draft_intel_note: Preferred long-term Carolina back if healthy, but avoid assuming an immediate full workhorse split.
Jonathon Brooks.news_note: Chuba Hubbard hamstring absence improves Brooks near-term opportunity, though analysts still expect a meaningful split when both are healthy.

Terrance Ferguson.draft_intel_note: Analysts specifically identified Ferguson as a late-round upside beneficiary if Puka Nacua misses time.

Rome Odunze.draft_intel_note: Luther Burden return to practice slightly reduces the clean target-share case; monitor two-WR personnel usage.

MarShawn Lloyd.draft_intel_note: Preferred contingency handcuff if drafting Josh Jacobs in a deep 14-team league; suspension/injury uncertainty raises immediate relevance.
